requirement_summary: 对象、时间、claim、risk 与签名组 Schema 校验及负例拒绝。
codeflowmu_evidence: Protocol package 5 valid and 3 expected-invalid fixtures PASS
executed_assertions: CodeFlowMu agent/task/review/session/skill positive and negative fixtures PASS
missing_assertions: Complete S0.5 canonical governance-object negative suite on the product
limitations: CodeFlowMu schemas are not the complete S0.5 canonical object surface
claim_boundary: Schema paths and selected negative fixtures are demonstrated; full product C01 is not.

requirement_summary: 单一主载体、父子派生、可归属对象与单写者不可变性。
protocol_evidence: TMPA Core S0.5 C02 parent/derivation and primary carrier rules
reference_implementation_evidence: public API and MCP surface snapshot failures
codeflowmu_evidence: Parent dispatch, report parenting and child archive gate tests ran in full suites
missing_assertions: One product S0.5 Reader primary_carrier conflict judgment
limitations: Downstream passing tests cannot erase the reference implementation boundary failure
claim_boundary: The concept is aligned, but FCoP v3.2.5 persistence/read surface is not closed.

requirement_summary: 相同对象 ID 的不同内容必须保留并隔离为重复冲突。
codeflowmu_evidence: Deduplication and file-store tests executed in Runtime/Shell suites
claim_boundary: Mechanisms are demonstrated, canonical product output is not.

requirement_summary: 流内序列连续性与多异步流独立推进。
codeflowmu_evidence: Mailbox FIFO, priority, independent workers and dispatch tests PASS
case_evidence: WP-13 shows failed subexecution followed by same-work continuation
executed_assertions: Local order and asynchronous progress paths passed
missing_assertions: Canonical STREAM_GAP and STREAM_DUPLICATE_SEQUENCE product output across permutations
limitations: Application queue tests are not a full S0.5 Reader
claim_boundary: Ordering mechanisms are demonstrated only at implementation/application level.

requirement_summary: 按角色与操作判定授权，区分 denied 与 undetermined。
reference_implementation_evidence: FCoP role lock and authority tests
codeflowmu_evidence: AuthorityGuard, RoleToolPolicy and operation approval suites PASS
case_evidence: WP-13 has DEV and role-separated QA evidence
missing_assertions: Product canonical AUTHORITY_DENIED/invalid and AUTHORITY_UNDETERMINED/undetermined pair
limitations: Some responsibility separation remains policy/role-label based rather than verified real-world identity
claim_boundary: Role gates exist and ran; complete three-valued S0.5 authority output did not.

requirement_summary: 合法生命周期迁移、状态证据冲突，以及 lifecycle 与 business acceptance 分离。
codeflowmu_evidence: LifecycleStateMachine/Governor, project graph and archive gate tests PASS
case_evidence: WP-13 ends review/pending and explicitly denies terminal acceptance
missing_assertions: Product canonical ILLEGAL_TRANSITION and LIFECYCLE_UNDETERMINED output
claim_boundary: Separation and gates are demonstrated, complete S0.5 output is not.

requirement_summary: 职责分离、人工控制、例外与验收授权。
codeflowmu_evidence: Runtime acceptance test actual text '需 ADMIN/PM 人工裁定' did not match expected '需 ADMIN 人工裁定|需人工裁定'
case_evidence: WP-13 role-separated QA; PM final approval not present
executed_assertions: Mandatory human-readable adjudication prompt contract assertion failed
missing_assertions: Verified real identity separation and exception-object end-to-end product output
Adjudication of whether ADMIN/PM is an intended product contract or the test expectation is outdated
limitations: Actual Chinese and structured fields are valid; product-versus-test prompt contract ownership is unresolved
Role-separated author QA is not independent identity validation
claim_boundary: Human-control structure exists and text encoding is valid, but one mandatory prompt-contract assertion failed; C07 remains FAIL until adjudication, corresponding change, and rerun.

requirement_summary: 内容完整性摘要重算与受控篡改检测。
codeflowmu_evidence: General integrity and checksum mechanisms exist
missing_assertions: Pinned product Reader recomputes S0.5 object digest after controlled tampering
limitations: Package checksum validation is not the product C08 tamper assertion
claim_boundary: Adjacent integrity evidence cannot substitute for the unexecuted product criterion.

requirement_summary: 缺失引用或 claim evidence 时阻断并传播不确定性。
codeflowmu_evidence: Dependency waiting, missing fact and UNKNOWN tests PASS
case_evidence: WP-13 preserves unavailable exit status rather than inventing success
executed_assertions: Missing dependencies/facts block or produce UNKNOWN
missing_assertions: Canonical product MISSING_REFERENCE with undetermined/partial propagation
claim_boundary: Failure visibility is demonstrated; canonical propagation is not.

requirement_summary: 检测禁止环并只隔离受影响子图。
codeflowmu_evidence: Runtime WP-14 recovery test 'rejects abnormal parent links and detects cycles' PASS
executed_assertions: Abnormal parent and cycle detection passed in current local Runtime suite
missing_assertions: Product Reader quarantines only the affected prohibited-cycle subgraph
limitations: Evidence is from an unpublished local snapshot
The published S0.5 product baseline had this criterion NOT RUN
claim_boundary: Fresh local cycle detection supports PARTIAL only, not canonical product PASS.

requirement_summary: 固定输入全集排列产生字节稳定的 Envelope、graph 与 issues。
protocol_evidence: TMPA Core S0.5 C11 complete 24-permutation requirement
reference_implementation_evidence: Reference Reader C11 PASS over 24 permutations
missing_assertions: Product byte-stable S0.5 Envelope permutation run
limitations: Reference Reader result cannot be transferred to products
claim_boundary: Only the author Reference Reader satisfies the fixture.

requirement_summary: 冲突事实保持 disputed，直至授权 resolution。
codeflowmu_evidence: Append-only correction and decision services exist
case_evidence: WP-13 retains earlier failed execution evidence
missing_assertions: One product run emits disputed view and authorized resolution as S0.5 output
limitations: Evidence retention alone is not the full conflict-resolution criterion
claim_boundary: Adjacent mechanisms exist; exact product assertion was not run.

requirement_summary: 失败恢复、父子闭包及无隐藏运行态的工作重建。
protocol_evidence: TMPA Core S0.5 C13 CHILD_WORK_OPEN and recovery rules
codeflowmu_evidence: childTaskArchiveGate and startup recovery tests ran
case_evidence: WP-13 preserves failed subexecution then resumes same work
executed_assertions: Cold reconstruction without hidden thinking PASS
missing_assertions: Fresh unified product Reader reconstructs responsibility, lifecycle, dependencies and issues in one canonical result
limitations: Mechanisms are distributed across application services, not one S0.5 Reader
claim_boundary: No-session file-fact recovery is demonstrated; full criterion remains partial.

requirement_summary: 仅在所需验收／归档授权后进入终态历史并保留全部对象。
codeflowmu_evidence: Archive guards, child closure gates and terminal history paths executed
case_evidence: WP-13 explicitly remains review/pending and denies final approval/archive
limitations: PASS does not imply Gate C or release completion
claim_boundary: C14 product-level history/authorization behavior is supported; independent adoption is not.
